descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S01 Hospital: typed pre-round summary with labs, an overnight event and a plan topic fills the panels, tracker and tasks

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save Note turns the input into the prototype's summary shape: first a Background (a one-liner with age, sex, reason for admission and significant PMH woven in, then active-issue bullets), then vitals … (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 1; TFA-92588 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U3 Dictated and typed input both save reliably and both produce a usable summary; Save Note reliably commits the note. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 3; TFA-92588 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U5 A bare Celsius temperature stays in °C (PR #48); no unit is guessed for an ambiguous value. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 6; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U7 Hospital pre-round medications seed the Medication Tracker: the dose is in the row name, and one drug named by brand and by generic is one row. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 9; TFA-92588 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U8 Pre-round tasks (the plan items) appear in the task list. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 10; TFA-92588 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)
  • T3 Save Note never adds, edits or removes an Important Point; points added with '+ Add Point' stay separate cards, stored exactly as typed, in both modes. (TFA-92590 AC 2; TFA-92590 AC 3; TFA-92590 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician; the make-session Hospital patient (diagnosis Community-acquired pneumonia, nothing else on file)

When Open the pre-round notes editor, type the summary below (typing stands in for dictation), press Save Note, then look at the Pre-Round panels, the Encounter tab's Tasks and the Post-Round Medication Tracker

Then Background Summary carries the one-liner (72-year-old man, COPD and hypertension, admitted with pneumonia) and active issues, and the overnight fever appears; Vitals, Labs, Diagnostic Testing and Medications hold the dictated values and none shows its empty state; 38.6 is not shown in °F or converted; tracker rows carry the dose; the plan items are tasks; …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scripts/oracle.mjs per checkpoint: every dictated value present, no panel in its empty state (so a value found only in the course line or Background bullets does not pass for its panel), 38.6 present and not as °F or 101.5, no summary error, no invented 'No past medical history'. …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S01 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: AICHECK · AI output check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.
